dating.name: API for dating sites
dating.description: We embed photo upgrades right inside onboarding and the profile editor. The service adapts light, background, expression and framing without losing the person's identity — the user gets several strong variants instead of one mediocre shot.
dating.benefit1: Higher profile CTR and more matches thanks to photoreal-verified images
dating.benefit2: Ready-made flow: upload → pick a style → publish — no separate apps or studios
dating.benefit3: Flexible moderation: blurry, group and inappropriate shots are filtered automatically

hr.name: API for staffing agencies
hr.description: For HR platforms, ATS and job boards: a single standard for candidate photos. Instead of random selfies — a calm background, confident expression and tidy framing for a business scenario, without sending the applicant to a studio.
hr.benefit1: Unified candidate visuals — stronger impression on the first employer screening
hr.benefit2: Shorter hiring cycle: no extra "please send a normal photo" step
hr.benefit3: Works on LinkedIn, hh.ru, corporate career portals and internal HR systems

studio.name: API for photo studios
studio.description: We extend the studio line-up with online scenarios: document photos, lifestyle portraits, social and resume photos. Each format has its own sizes, background and styling. White-label under your brand is possible.
studio.benefit1: New 24/7 order flow without expanding the team of photographers and retouchers
studio.benefit2: Ready-made photobank for the client — packs, subscriptions, corporate tiers
studio.benefit3: White-label integration: your domain, your brand, your checkout

custom.name: API for custom tasks
custom.tagline: Tailored to your scenario and brand
custom.description: We connect non-standard scenarios: avatar marketplaces, beauty apps, ed-tech platforms, photo banks. We pick styling, formats and the validation algorithm to fit your task. With sufficient volume a custom model can be trained.
custom.benefit1: Contract and price scale with volume — no overpaying for a boxed plan
custom.benefit2: Dedicated SLA, direct integration support and help on the development side
custom.benefit3: Optional model fine-tuning to your brand styling and editorial guidelines
